name: BRYAN YOUNG PLUMBING
address: 380 SE BRIDGEFORD BLVD STE A, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Front Driveway; Landscaped Area; Landscaped Area; Open Lawn Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep all secondary access points unlocked and clearly identifiable for responding units.
• Mark each access point with a visible indicator so responders can quickly locate all entry options.
• Remove or relocate any parked vehicles from the driveway that would block a responding unit from reaching the residence.
• Keep the open lawn area clear of parked vehicles so responding units can use it for staging or turnaround when driveway space is limited.
• Trim any landscaping along the driveway edges that narrows the usable width for larger emergency vehicles.
• Keep shrubs and plantings near access points trimmed back so they do not obstruct a responder's view of gates, doors, or pathways.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Limited Vegetation Separation; Wood Piles; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove or relocate wood piles away from the house and any other structures to a separate, open storage area.
• Thin trees within the scattered clusters closest to the house to create open space between individual trees.
• Trim the lower branches of trees near the house to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Clear shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to the house and any outbuildings.
• Separate remaining shrub plantings from trees so fire cannot move directly from shrubs into tree canopy.
• Thin shrubs in areas where they are clustered close together near structures.
• Keep the open terrain areas around the house free of dry grass, dead plant material, and loose debris.
• Increase the gap between the nearest tree clusters and the walls of the house by removing trees or large shrubs within that space.
